comment: C-first source candidate for pray.c:pleased -> give_spell. Wish a luckstone, neutral altar, one lawful white unicorn corpse and seven red dragon corpses before offering any of them. This tests the source-relevant queued-wishes state: zap.c makewish increases u.ublesscnt, while aligned altar sacrifices reduce it; batching the high-value corpses lets the route reach positive Luck after the cooldown clears. Offer the pile in its observed floor-letter order with per-corpse confirmation, then use the wizard prayer-confirmation path and advance through pagers to inspect the actual pleased() case.
